newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 3.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- U.S. forces strike military targets in southern Iraq today.
-- European fighter aircraft manufacturers need to unite to face U.S. competitors who have undergone major restructuring as well as Russian rivals.
-- Chairman Louis Gallois wants SNCF railway operator to increase market penetration.
-- Retail group Promodes sells money losing German unit to Spar Handels of Germany.
-- Minority shareholders of ailing bank Credit Foncier de France launch legal action contesting its 1995 accounts.
